creator: opichillc
title: Process for debugging a Lovable/Supabase login failure with first users: post a notice, capture browser console errors, have the agent check server logs and Supabase auth logs, then follow up with users

tools.name: Supabase
tools.detail: Auth logs if not on Lovable Cloud

tools.name: Browser DevTools (Inspect / console)
tools.detail: right-click > Inspect, reproduce error, copy console logs

claims: First 10 users' experience is key; done right they become ambassadors
Process generalizes to any user-facing bug: communicate with customers, capture logs, give the AI agent all details before proceeding
how_to_steps: Post a notice on the login page acknowledging the issue and giving a path to ask questions
Right-click > Inspect, reproduce the error, copy console errors
Paste errors to the Lovable agent and ask it to check the terminal for server-side errors
If not on Lovable Cloud, pull Supabase Auth logs (agent can walk you through it)
Let the agent diagnose and fix; then remove the support notice and answer every user question promptly
on_screen_only: Header 'Debugging a Lovable App?'; talking head only
cta: Follow/like; comment if this happened to you

relevance.why: Haji uses Claude Code, not Lovable, and the debugging loop (console + server logs + auth logs to the agent) is basic for a veteran. Customer-communication step is sensible but obvious

implement_score.why: Nothing to build; at most a checklist reminder to add a status banner and gather console/Supabase auth logs before prompting Claude

gap.what: duplicate of liked content (Supabase/auth debugging basics already covered by login-security and Supabase videos)
